title: Beloved
author: Toni Morrison
current_text: In February 2013, a parent in Fairfax County filed a complaint to remove Beloved from AP English classrooms because she said it had given her son nightmares; the Fairfax County school board did not take up the complaint.

sources.quote: This issue began in February of 2013, when a parent in Fairfax County filed a complaint to have Beloved removed from AP English classrooms because it had given her son nightmares. The Fairfax County school board felt the complaint was not a priority for the large district, and did not take it up.
